response.note: Compares NovaMart attempt volumes and success rates between 4-17 Oct and 18-31 Oct broken down by payment method family, acquirer and failure category to surface the drivers of the drop (assumes status value 'SUCCESS' denotes success).
response.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' THEN 'p2_oct18_31' ELSE 'p1_oct04_17' END AS period, method_family, acquirer_name, failure_category, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successes, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE merchant_name = 'NovaMart' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-04' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY period, attempts DESC LIMIT 50
